name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the vibrant liveries of rally cars he'd see tearing through the Hungarian countryside. He started his career in automotive bodywork, quickly mastering the art of paint application and color matching. His dedication and precision caught the eye of a local racing team, and he soon found himself responsible for the visual presentation of their cars.

At Rexal FMI Racing, Zoltán is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to perfection. He sees each car as a canvas, striving to create a finish that not only looks stunning but also enhances aerodynamics. His innovative techniques for applying lightweight coatings have earned him recognition within the team and beyond. He is also surprisingly adept at managing team morale and his easy-going approach makes him a favorite among the mechanics.

What sets Zoltán apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with artistic flair. He's not just applying paint; he's crafting a visual identity that reflects the team's spirit and ambition. His calm demeanor, even under pressure, makes him an invaluable asset during race weekends.

physical.description: Zoltán is of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always polishes his spray guns meticulously before and after each use.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Has a habit of sketching livery designs on napkins during lunch breaks.
